ai_summary: Here is the executive summary:  Magnifica Global Opportunities Fund, a non-promoter investor, has significantly reduced its stake in AAA Technologies Limited through an open market sale, decreasing its holding from 7.13% to 2.26% (a material disposal of 4.87% of total voting capital). Key red flags in this disclosure include a transaction date of October 9, 2026, which is in the future, and a significant numerical inconsistency where the reported share counts and percentages do not align with the stated total equity share capital, raising questions about the accuracy of the reported figures.
